A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a hybrid sampling Bayesian Occupancy filter which is able to handle both static and dynamic environments.

we propose a new model to represent the environment, based on a hybrid sampling of the occupancy grid and on the estimation of the occupancy velocity distribution, which is more compact, more accurate and better suited to embedded systems.

the Hybrid Sampling Bayesian Occupancy Filter (HSBOF) is a new framework which combines the advantages of the BOF (compact representation of the environment, robustness, and easy integration) with a new representation of the environment which is able to handle dynamic environments and which is more compact than the classic representation.
